quiz.q3: Option 2's why describes only replacing the hypotenuse denominator by the adjacent side, which would produce 56/56 from the correct cosine fraction. Explain that 33/56 uses opposite over adjacent, giving tangent instead of cosine.

theory: The fact asserting that $\sin\theta$ and $\sin\alpha$ are different fractions in the same triangle is false for an isosceles right triangle, where both acute angles are $45^{\circ}$ and both sine ratios are equal. Qualify the statement to say the ratios can differ because opposite and adjacent depend on the chosen angle, while retaining the requirement to name the angle.
summary: Qualified the theory fact so sine ratios for the two acute angles can differ, while retaining the requirement to name the angle.
